# Chapter 5 (S041–S050): Balthazar, Moonrise, Ketheric, Act 3 Lower City, Sarevok, Orin's deal
## Story so far
- S041: Balthazar and the Apostate skeleton army on the Nightsong's plateau: two wipes, third try won (Hunger of Hadar blinded him, hasted Karlach killed him r2, Turn the Unholy). Attacked him rather than let him take the Nightsong.
- S042: Nightsong spared (Persuasion DC14), Shadowheart lost her weapon to Shar, Wyll got the Moonlight Glaive. Long rest (camp works after the Shadowfell). Moonrise Towers main-floor assault (Z'rell + Zealots) lost once, won on retry from the doorway with Hypnotic Pattern and Spirit Guardians; Jaheira and Harpers lived.
- S043: wrong stairs led down to Moonrise Prison; optional necromite fight won in 11 rounds but Jaheira died (Revivify refused). Quartermaster Talli, supplies.
- S044: first floor via the throne-room staircase; Radija killed; roof fight won (Ketheric carried off with the Nightsong). Jumped into the Mind Flayer Colony, freed Mizora (right device), Wyll got the Infernal Rapier; Necrotic Lab fight started.
- S045: Lab won clean; Restoration pod; cutscene (Gortash + Orin took the Elder Brain and Duke Ravengard). Ketheric finale lost first (Aylin killed), retry freed Aylin r3.
- S046: Ketheric + Apostate of Myrkul dead r7; Netherstone (Wyll carries); Dream Visitor gave Get the Netherstone / Gather Your Allies; Wyll's pact story; Thisobald Thorm killed at the Waning Moon; Reithwin waypoint; Act 3 transition.
- S047: fast_travel to Baldur's Gate → Lower City. Investigate the Murders: Devella refused, Rainforest's Home (Bloodstained Parchment), Beehive trader, Cora saved at the Wine Festival, Dolor's doppelgangers killed, Candulhallow's cellar door found. Mohan at Central Wall.
- S048: all four L8; Dolor killed at Facemaker's (Figaro saved), passphrase from the Dirge page, death knights passed with a victim's hand; Orin murdered Zevlor in camp; Tribunal fight with Sarevok began.
- S049: Sarevok + 3 Echoes won on retry (hall door closed, kill Echo of Amelyssan first); loot Amulet of Bhaal, Sword of Chaos; Valeria freed; failed Deception on Aelis → grease fight.
- S050: reloaded; Aelis talked down (Persuasion DC18); Orin (as Gale) offered a deal: Gale kidnapped, kill Gortash first; new quest Disable the Steel Watch; Foundry front mob killed, Volo died; stuck at the locked Foundry doors.
## Key decisions
- Spared the Nightsong (S042); attacked Balthazar (S041); freed Mizora with the right device (S044); refused Thisobald's drink (S046); "no interest in being judged" to Sarevok (S048); accepted Orin's deal (S050). See decisions.md.
## Lessons from this chapter
- Blind bosses with Hunger of Hadar; Radiant is often resisted by undead/constructs; keep Wyll behind cover; never travel_to into a boss hall (regroup, move_to); close doors to keep adds out; Turn the Unholy also turns our Cambion.
- combat_turn auto-fallback can attack allies: never target allies in combat_turn; shared-turn bug fixed by save+load; "on_reaction":"use" for Shield Blow.
- Don't fight Aelis; pass by Persuasion.
## Loose ends carried forward
- Foundry entry (Scroll of Knock on the south gate), Gortash, Netherstone, Orin/Gale (never enter her temple before Gortash dies).
- Emperor's Old Hideout, Chef Roveer, Nesha Leesha, Nightsong (Lorroakan), Devella, Aylin, Mol, camp supplies 35/40.
